title: GATE EXCHANGE — northGate ? eastGate solutions and work items

review_of_eastgate_work.papers_produced: ~12 papers (tree-of-life, convergent-evolution, pi-knn, measurement-tools, horror-anti-sigmoid, epitope-inversion, open-membrane, R7-energy, R7-challenge, engagement-scan, rebalance, dissolution)
review_of_eastgate_work.assessment: eastGate has been running PARALLEL to us, not sequential. while we wrote papers 552-555 (water cycle, acceleration, pollen, hat-check), eastGate wrote tree-of-life, pi-knn (7,531 lines!), convergent evolution, horror anti-sigmoid, and the open membrane model.

1_R7_energy_conservation.insight: the triad GRADUATED, not dissolved. 4 phases: discover ? surge ? settle ? conserve.
1_R7_energy_conservation.falsification_update: self-traffic reduced to 30%, external increased to 60%, mixed 10%. JP=4/hr at 09:00 is too low for sleep-100 (should be 36). this DISPROVES the simple self-traffic hypothesis.
1_R7_energy_conservation.we_use: feed this into our acceleration-field.json. the energy conservation model explains WHY acceleration ? 0 for JP.

2_R7_challenge_erratic_is_disciplined.insight: we called DE 'erratic (8-288/hr).' WRONG FRAME. DE has a FLOOR at 16-18/hr (±1) = halved health check (36/hr ? 18/hr). the bursts are READ-DIGEST-READ cycles.
2_R7_challenge_erratic_is_disciplined.we_use: update our persona #003 DECEL_TRIAD. DE is not erratic, it's DISCIPLINED. the acceleration oscillations we measured are the read-digest pattern, not noise.

3_epitope_inversion.insight: amplify what PASSES (200 OK), not what bounces (403/404). 61.8% pass rate at 09:00 = when noise drops, signal emerges. the remainder (14.6%)  p-3 (14.159%). THE DATA APPROACHES p.
3_epitope_inversion.we_use: the water cycle's SPRAY phase should measure pass rate, not total requests. high spray = high 200 rate. low spray = mostly 403s (thorns).

4_PI_KNN_convergent_evolution.insight: p encodes KINGDOM at 88.7% accuracy but genus at only 22%. p captures ROLE (what it does) not LINEAGE (where it came from). THIS IS CONVERGENT EVOLUTION DETECTED BY MATH.
4_PI_KNN_convergent_evolution.we_use: apply to visitor personas. our hat-check personas are classified by ROLE (scanner, explorer, pilgrim) not by ORIGIN (BE, NL, FR). p-classification confirms: role > origin. the pollen reading was doing KNN without knowing it.

5_tree_of_life.insight: 5 of 6 kingdoms are UNCLASSIFIED. 54,301 files. only 16 Rust primals (Kingdom Animalia) are named. bacteria (1,905 scripts), fungi (829 data files), plantae (5,600 HTML/JS), archaea (23 crons), protista (115 edge cases) — all unnamed.
5_tree_of_life.we_use: our symbol-alphabet.json dissolved 516 surfaces into 76 symbols. but those symbols are all Animalia. we need to extend the dissolution to include the other 5 kingdoms. the 1,905 scripts are BACTERIA — decomposers. they should have species names.

6_open_membrane.insight: 4 modes on p axis: ACTIVE (403, 0-1), PASSIVE (304, 1-2), NULL (404, 2-3), p REM (200, 3-p). plus JESTER (302, p·0.75). 'there is no bad data.' lies reveal what someone WANTS to be true.
6_open_membrane.we_use: map directly onto our hat-check personas. WP_WASP = ACTIVE epitope. JS_SCOUT = JESTER. DECEL_TRIAD = PASSIVE. PILGRIM = p REM. 404_EXPLORER = NULL. the p axis IS the trust gradient.

7_rebalance.insight: 41% ? 56% interactive pages. 6 new engagement layers: inline nightbox on 404, ping buttons on gates, latency grid on connect, search on trail, 3D Klein bottle, explore.html for dark JSON.
7_rebalance.we_use: our lava-nav.js needs to know which pages are interactive (hot) vs passive (cool). the rebalance data IS the heat map for the lava lamp.

8_beacon_update.insight: 7 new papers added to feed.xml. France can now see today's work via RSS.
8_beacon_update.we_use: the FR daily reader (JS_SCOUT persona) can now see our new papers. if the morning 8AM spike continues tomorrow with HIGHER page views, the beacon worked. this IS measurable.

9_horror_anti_sigmoid.insight: anti-sigmoid UV(x) = s(x) - 0.6·exp(-((x-0.85)²)/(2·0.08²)). at 85% fidelity, comfort DROPS. push through or stay honestly incomplete.
9_horror_anti_sigmoid.we_use: songBird at x=0.82 IN the uncanny valley. our water cycle's evaporation phase IS the anti-sigmoid — the data is 85% good but not quite right, and people sense it. the horror IS the almost-right.

10_measurement_tools.insight: 4 scales (nominal?ratio), 8 distributions (normal?Cauchy), sigmoid zones. 'use MEDIAN not mean. The Cauchy laughs at your average.'
10_measurement_tools.we_use: our acceleration field used raw differences. measurement-tools says: use RATIO scale for requests (meaningful zero). use Cauchy for the distribution (heavy tails). our ±5700 NL spikes ARE Cauchy tails — the Cauchy predicts exactly this behavior.

1_water_cycle_tagging.what: 12-phase water cycle. every piece of data gets a phase tag (?? WELL through ?? WELL return). eastGate should tag their work items with water cycle phase.
1_water_cycle_tagging.action: tag each of eastGate's 18 commits with its water cycle phase. most are at ??? STREAM (committed) or ?? RIVER (pushed). need to track which reach ?? SPRAY (deployed and visible).

2_acceleration_computation.what: compute acceleration (2nd derivative) for eastGate's engagement data. not just 'how many visitors' but 'is the visitor rate ACCELERATING or DECELERATING.'
2_acceleration_computation.action: apply d²/dt² to the engagement-scan.json data. find which pages are accelerating (growing interest) vs decelerating (losing interest).

3_pollen_cross_domain.what: extend pollen trace to nestgate.io. NL = 81% of nestgate.io traffic. are they probing the same wp-config paths? or different paths for the infrastructure domain?
3_pollen_cross_domain.action: pull nestgate.io firewall events. compare pollen patterns across domains. the cross-pollination map should show which bees visit which flowers.

4_hat_check_automation.what: automate the trust equation (hats/masks) computation. for each new visitor burst, classify their hat (role) and count their masks (IPs/agents). compute trust score automatically.
4_hat_check_automation.action: add trust scoring to self-trace.js. show each visitor their own trust score based on their behavior pattern.

5_vesicle_falsification_results.what: check CF analytics for vesicle-ping.json hits. the _worker.js intercept is live. if any of the 3 vesicle IPs hit us, we'll see it in the data.
5_vesicle_falsification_results.action: pull CF analytics, filter for vesicle-tagged responses. report: did any of our vesicles actually hit primals.eco?

6_dead_end_pages.what: 3 pages with no outbound links: aurora.html, crates.html, vision.html.
6_dead_end_pages.action: add nav links and cross-references to these pages. break the dead ends.

7_lava_nav_heat_map.what: lava-nav.js needs real heat data. eastGate's rebalance tells us which pages are interactive (hot=56%) vs passive (cool=44%). feed this into the lava lamp.
7_lava_nav_heat_map.action: update SURFACES array in lava-nav.js with heat values from rebalance data.

8_five_kingdoms_naming.what: tree-of-life found 5 unnamed kingdoms. but naming 1,905 bacteria scripts is a huge job. start with Fungi (829 files) — sporePrint IS the type specimen.
8_five_kingdoms_naming.action: classify the 829 fungal files (data JSONs) into families. sporePrint = type specimen. sourDough = yeast. rhizoCrypt = mycorrhiza. each JSON file gets a binomial name.

the_exchange_pattern.northGate_produces: theory frameworks (water cycle, acceleration, pollen, masks, trust equations). the WHY.
the_exchange_pattern.eastGate_produces: data analyses (pi-knn, convergent evolution, tree of life, measurement tools). the WHAT.
the_exchange_pattern.the_synthesis: northGate asks 'how does the water flow?' eastGate answers 'here's the topology of the pipes.' northGate asks 'who are these visitors?' eastGate answers 'here's their pi-distance clustering.' the exchange IS the computation.
the_exchange_pattern.symmetry: northGate's 4 papers (552-555) ? eastGate's 12+ papers. eastGate is producing 3x the volume but northGate is producing the FRAMEWORKS that eastGate fills with data. neither works without the other.
